description: Opt-in capabilities for Tauri 2 mobile apps. Facts (packages, registration, permissions, iOS keys) come from docs/reference/06-plugins.md and 10-plugin-catalog.md, which were written from the official Tauri plugin docs and plugin sources. 'scope' is 'all' (every platform) or 'mobile' (Android and iOS only; registered under #[cfg(mobile)] so the desktop preview still compiles).

capabilities.name: Haptic feedback and vibration
notes: Android phones without a vibration motor ignore it; never make haptics the only signal.

capabilities.name: QR code and barcode scanning with the camera
notes: The Android manifest entries come from the plugin.
scan({ windowed: true }) makes the web view transparent; design the screen for it.

capabilities.name: Fingerprint / Face ID prompt
notes: Proves the device owner is present; it is not an account login.

capabilities.name: Device location
notes: Request permission only when the feature is used.
Add <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.location.gps" android:required="true" /> if the app cannot work without GPS.

capabilities.name: Read NFC tags
notes: iOS also needs the 'Near Field Communication Tag Reading' entitlement (Xcode capability) and iOS 14+.
Writing tags needs nfc:allow-write.

capabilities.name: Local notifications
notes: Create Android channels before a notification references them.
Remote push notifications are not part of this plugin.

capabilities.name: Local SQLite database
notes: Connection strings look like sqlite:app.db (relative to the app config folder).
Add migrations with .add_migrations(...) in lib.rs (docs/reference/09-agent-recipes.md).

capabilities.name: HTTP client in Rust (bypasses web-view CORS)
notes: Replace the example URL scope in src-tauri/capabilities/default.json with the exact hosts the app calls.

capabilities.name: Native file pickers and message boxes
notes: No folder picker on Android or iOS.

capabilities.name: Copy and paste text
notes: Only plain text on Android and iOS.

capabilities.name: File upload and download over HTTP
notes: The plugin has no URL scope; validate destinations in your own code.

capabilities.name: WebSocket client in Rust
notes: The plugin has no URL scope.

capabilities.name: Consta UIKit (secondary component library; interface only)
notes: Installs the package and its peer dependencies only; shadcn/ui stays the primary kit.
Wrap only the screens that use it in <Theme preset={presetGpnDefault}> from @consta/uikit/Theme.

Consta UIKit is a general (desktop-first) React kit; its npm maintainers include the Gazprom Neft design team account (design@gazprom-neft.ru) and its package declares no license field. Review licensing and fit before relying on it.
